title: dortmanna coronopifolia var. ceratophylla
intro: Dortmanna coronopifolia var. ceratophylla, commonly known as the "Rat Tail," is a type of plant that belongs to the family Urticaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Dortmanna coronopifolia var. ceratophylla include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and fungal infections.
